atomic_facts.fact: Christopher James Evans was born on 1 April 1966.
Christopher James Evans is an English television presenter, radio DJ, and producer.
He presented The One Show on Fridays between 2010 and 2015.
He co-hosted Radio 2 Live in Hyde Park between 2011 and 2018.
In 2015, he signed a three-year deal to lead a new Top Gear line-up.
He presented a revival series of TFI Friday in 2015.
He stepped down as presenter of Top Gear in July 2016 (announced 4 July 2016).
He moved to Virgin Radio UK to present its breakfast show, announced in September 2018.
Chris Evans the British TV presenter is a different person from the Chris Evans who plays Captain America.
Chris Evans the British TV presenter has never been credited as playing Captain America in any Marvel Studios film.
